Class ContractProbes

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.ContractProbes
public final class ContractProbes extends Object
Executable checks for the application contract.

Every mechanically checkable clause runs in the application's own test suite, before deploy. Runtime fail-closed checks are unaffected. Probes move discovery earlier and replace nothing.

probe(Parsley, Samples, Path) drives the application's own Parsley.testTopology() under TopologyTestDriver with caller-supplied sample records, and checks what the driver can see: key codecs canonical on the samples, every observed output stamped with parseable causal headers and decodable by its topic's declared codecs, handlers total on their samples, and emissions confined to declared sinks. It runs broker-less, and needs kafka-streams-test-utils on the test classpath, an optional dependency of this library.

probeCluster(Parsley, Admin) checks what only a live cluster can answer: declared topics exist, a stage's sources agree on partition count, which is the mechanical half of co-partitioning, and tick topics carry exactly the partition count of the stage's widest source.

A ContractProbes.Report separates failures from notes. Failures are observed contract violations, each naming the violated clause. Notes record coverage gaps, such as an unsampled source or a sink no sample reached, and the names the deployment must keep stable. A probe run with notes and no failures passed, with stated blind spots.

    • probe

      public static ContractProbes.Report probe(Parsley app, ContractProbes.Samples samples, Path stateDir)
      Runs the test-time probes against the application's own topology.

      Pass a per-test temporary directory as stateDir. A shared directory contends on one RocksDB lock.

      Parameters:
      app - the composed application
      samples - the sample records to pipe, at least one per source topic
      stateDir - the directory backing the driver's state stores
      Returns:
      the report, carrying both failures and notes

    • probeCluster

      public static ContractProbes.Report probeCluster(Parsley app, org.apache.kafka.clients.admin.Admin admin)
      Runs the cluster probes, covering everything the contract requires of topics that only a live cluster can answer.

      Read-only. The application is not started, and the Admin is borrowed rather than closed.

      Parameters:
      app - the composed application
      admin - an admin client for the target cluster
      Returns:
      the report, carrying failures and no notes
